title: Hot Hand
effect: Give the selected player +3 Mid-Range Shot and +3 Three-Point Shot before tip-off.
cleanup: Record the actual increases, respecting the editor's limits. Remove only those increases after the final buzzer.

title: Next Man Up
effect: Your highest-overall player is suspended for this match: give him 0 minutes. Call up the selected two-way player in his place and play him for at least half the game (24 minutes in a 48-minute game). Record the call-up's original attributes and overall, then boost his attributes until his overall rises by 3, capped at 99. In Player Lock, control the call-up. A strong performance means reaching the minutes target AND either scoring 20 points or recording a double-double.
duration: One match; a successful call-up keeps +1 overall permanently
cleanup: After the game, restore the call-up's original attributes first. If he met the minutes and performance targets, adjust his attributes to finish 1 overall above his original rating, capped at 99. Otherwise keep his original rating. Restore the star's availability and normal rotation. If no two-way player is available, draw another event.
